DANCE 170.description: Improves technique through strengthening, toning, and coordination. Bulletin credit max is 3 across repeated enrollments.

DANCE 221.name: Introduction to African Dance and Culture
DANCE 221.description: Introduces traditional West African dance movements and culture.

DANCE 225.name: Introduction to Hip Hop
DANCE 225.description: Introduction to Hip Hop and the elements of the genre. Bulletin credit max is 6 across repeated enrollments.

DANCE 230.name: Ballet
DANCE 230.description: Exploration of ballet technique. Bulletin credit max is 6 across repeated enrollments.

DANCE 240.name: Jazz Dance
DANCE 240.description: Exploration of jazz dance styles throughout American history. Bulletin credit max is 6 across repeated enrollments.

DANCE 250.name: Tap Dance
DANCE 250.description: Exploration of tap dance technique. Bulletin credit max is 6 across repeated enrollments.

DANCE 260.name: Introduction to Modern Dance
DANCE 260.description: Introduces modern dance elements and components. Bulletin credit max is 6 across repeated enrollments.

DANCE 270.name: Introduction to Bartenieff Fundamentals
DANCE 270.description: Covers movement efficiency and expression through dynamic alignment.

DANCE 410.name: Dance History
DANCE 410.description: Survey of dance history concerning perspectives of culture, race, and gender.

DANCE 261.name: Beginning Modern Dance I
DANCE 261.description: Beginning modern dance technique, designed for any student with an interest in Modern Dance. Bulletin credit max is 6 across repeated enrollments. Its own description states it 'serves as a prerequisite for DANCE 262.'

DANCE 361.name: Intermediate Modern Dance I
DANCE 361.description: Intermediate modern dance technique. Bulletin credit max is 6 across repeated enrollments. Bulletin's own literal prereq text cites 'DANCE 262', a course code that could not be independently confirmed to exist (absent from the department's own course listing and unsearchable) despite being referenced by both DANCE 361's and DANCE 261's descriptions -- substituted DANCE 261 (confirmed real, immediately prior in the same numbered sequence, and self-described as leading into it) rather than guessed at or left unmodeled.

DANCE 362.name: Intermediate Modern Dance II
DANCE 362.description: Continuation of intermediate modern dance technique. Bulletin credit max is 6 across repeated enrollments.

DANCE 499.name: Dance Foreign Study
DANCE 499.description: Dance courses offered in foreign countries by individual or group instruction. Bulletin credit range is 1-12cr, max 12; modeled at 3cr, matching the Acting B.F.A. plan's required semester in London.

DANCE 231.name: Beginning Ballet I
DANCE 231.description: Beginning ballet technique. Bulletin lists 'Admission into THRMT_BFA major' as its prereq, a program-standing gate the planner schema does not model directly.

DANCE 242.name: Beginning Jazz II
DANCE 242.description: Continuation of beginning jazz dance technique.

DANCE 251.description: Beginning tap dance technique. DANCE 252.name: Beginning Tap II
DANCE 252.description: Continuation of beginning tap dance technique.

DANCE 384.description: Musical theatre dance style, part II.

DANCE 431.description: Advanced ballet technique. One of the Musical Theatre B.F.A.'s 'Advanced Dance Elective' pool options (with DANCE 441/451).
